_about: Accepted exceptions for tests/run.py and viewer/test.html. Each is a real quirk of the game data, not a bug in the editor.

modelNotFound._why: The game's geometry def names a model its mesh file doesn't have; all are weapons or travel items, which the editor doesn't offer.

oversized._why: Pieces that really are bigger than the body (checked on screen): the Blazing archetypes' bird wings.
